summary: A status as a shape, a colour and a word together — Running, Failing, Paused. Every intent has its own shape, so the status survives greyscale and colour blindness; only the shape is coloured, and the word keeps the text colour.
useWhen: the status of each row in a table or list — an agent's state, a run's outcome, a job's health
a status beside other text, where a Badge's chip would shout

useInstead.when: a label that should stand out — a record's status in its header, Beta, New
useInstead.why: a Badge's chip draws the eye; a column of them turns a table into a wall of colour

useInstead.when: the steps of an agent's run
useInstead.why: it has the step vocabulary — pending, active, done, failed, skipped — and says which step is current

useInstead.when: the change must be announced — a job just failed
useInstead.why: StatusIndicator is not a live region; a table of them would announce every row

composition.note: `intent` picks the shape; `children` is the status in words, and is required.

success.use: healthy or done well: Running, Passed, Paid — a circle with a check

warning.use: needs attention, not broken: Expiring, Degraded — a triangle

error.use: failed or blocked: Failing, Rejected — an octagon with a cross

information.use: a fact worth marking: Draft, Scheduled — a circle with an i

neutral.use: the default — no judgement: Paused, Stopped — a ring

progress.use: under way right now: Deploying, Syncing — a spinning arc, still when motion is reduced

sm.use: the default — table cells and dense lists; 16px

guarantees: each intent has a different shape, so the status is not carried by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
the shape is hidden from assistive tech; the word is what is read
no role and no live region: it does not announce itself when it changes
the word keeps the text colour in every intent; only the shape takes the intent's icon colour
it stays on one line, so the shape is never left alone above its word
progress spins, and is still under `prefers-reduced-motion`; its shape alone says in progress
notes: pick the intent for what the status means to the user, not for its colour: Paused is neutral even if a designer wants it grey-blue
keep the word short — one or two words — and put the detail beside it or in a Tooltip on the cell

antiPatterns.why: a green dot and a red dot are the same shape; to a colour-blind user every row looks the same
a shape with no word has to be learned, and a sighted user cannot read the aria-label

antiPatterns.dont: a Badge with a dot in every row of a table
antiPatterns.why: the chips' backgrounds compete with the data, and the dot is the same shape for every status
